alert_news.title: First bullet train testing coach ready, Surat-Bilimora section targeted for 2027 commissioning
bullets: India’s first high‑speed rail corridor (Mumbai‑Ahmedabad High‑Speed Rail) with a 508‑km route; first testing coach built and ready for trials.
Surat‑Bilimora stretch will be the first operational section, slated for commissioning in 2027.
Project aims to cut Mumbai‑Ahmedabad travel time to ~90 minutes, marking the first bullet‑train service in India.

alert_news.title: India's first bullet train to hit tracks by May-June next year
bullets: India’s first indigenously built bullet train body frame completed; testing to commence May/June 2027.
First high‑speed train of the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad corridor, 508 km, will be the country’s inaugural bullet‑train service.
Testing phase expected 2‑4 months, after which the train will be inaugurated by the Prime Minister.

alert_news.title: India’s First Indigenous Optical Inter‑Satellite Link (OISL) Terminal Developed by Astrogate Labs
bullets: India’s first indigenous OISL terminal, a 10 Gbps laser communication system between satellites, developed by deep‑tech startup Astrogate Labs.
Targeted for full flight readiness by 2027, the terminal was demonstrated at the 9th Bengaluru Space Expo (BSX 2026) held at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre.

alert_news.title: ISRO's Another Milestone - Daily Excelsior
bullets: EOS‑05 is India’s first dedicated imaging satellite placed in geosynchronous transfer orbit, enabling continuous, near‑real‑time Earth observation.
Launched on GSLV‑Mk‑III, it is the heaviest satellite (≈2,300 kg) ever carried by an Indian GSLV rocket.
Provides persistent high‑resolution imagery for agriculture, disaster management, and regional monitoring.

alert_news.title: India's first privately built rocket developer achieves orbital launch capability
bullets: Skyroot Aerospace became the first Indian private company to develop a rocket that achieved orbital launch capability.
The company built India's first privately built rocket, marking a historic first for Indian private space ventures.
This milestone demonstrates the first time an Indian private firm successfully launched a rocket into orbit.

alert_news.title: India’s first geothermal wells commissioned in Ladakh
bullets: India’s first geothermal wells, each ~1,000 metres deep, commissioned by ONGC Energy Centre in Puga Valley, Ladakh (altitude >14,000 ft)
These wells support the development of India’s first 1‑MW demonstration geothermal power project

alert_news.title: Fortis Healthcare to Install India's First Upright Proton Therapy System
bullets: India’s first upright proton therapy system installed at Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Gurugram.
First Leo Cancer Care system in India, featuring MEVION S250‑FIT™ with upright positioning and RayStation® planning.

alert_news.title: Ladakh's Geothermal Energy: 5 Ways India Could Put Underground Heat to Work
bullets: 1,000‑metre‑deep geothermal wells at Puga Valley, Ladakh, part of a 1 MW pilot project – India’s first demonstration‑scale geothermal power project.
Wells recorded temperatures up to 135 °C at 400 m depth, demonstrating viable geothermal potential.

alert_news.title: India's first private commercial imaging satellite launched by Pixxel
bullets: India's first private commercial imaging satellite launched by Pixxel via SpaceX.
The satellite is part of Pixxel's Honeybee constellation, marking the first private sector imaging satellite in India.

alert_news.title: India's First Orbital Data Centre Satellite Launched by Sarvam and Pixxel
bullets: India’s first orbital data centre satellite, built by Sarvam in partnership with Pixxel
Enables real‑time data processing and storage for Earth observation, establishing sovereign Earth observation capabilities

alert_news.title: India's first hydrogen train completes 120 kmph trials, regular speed to rise to 110 kmph
bullets: India’s first hydrogen‑powered train, operated by Indian Railways, ran trials up to 120 kmph on the 89‑km Jind‑Sonipat route in Haryana
The train is now being upgraded to a regular operating speed of 110 kmph, with current maximum speed 75 kmph

alert_news.title: EOS-05 Completes First Orbit‑Raising Manoeuvre – India’s First Geosynchronous Imaging Satellite
bullets: EOS‑05 is India’s first imaging satellite designed to operate from a geosynchronous orbit (85.5° E), launched by ISRO on GSLV‑F17.
The satellite weighs 2,367 kg, the heaviest ever launched by a GSLV, and will provide continuous high‑frequency Earth imaging for nine years.

alert_news.title: India's First Hydrogen-Powered Train to Operate at 110 kmph
bullets: India’s first hydrogen-powered train, operating on the 89‑km Jind‑Sonipat route in Haryana, launched by Indian Railways
Trials reached 120 kmph; operational speed set at 110 kmph, marking the first commercial hydrogen train in India

alert_news.title: India's First Population Census With Digital Tools
bullets: India’s first population census conducted using digital tools, scheduled to begin on March 1, 2027, covering the entire country.

Four digital platforms—Houselisting Block Creator (HLBC) Web App, HLO Mobile App, Self‑Enumeration Portal, and Census Management & Monitoring System (CMMS)—will be deployed by the Office of the Registrar General under the Ministry of Home Affairs.

alert_news.title: India's First AI Innovation City Near Navi Mumbai Airport
bullets: India’s first AI innovation city, a 300‑acre development near Navi Mumbai International Airport, is slated for fast‑track approval with an investment of $11 billion.
The city will host AI data centres, high‑performance computing, semiconductor facilities, and global capability centres, establishing the country’s first dedicated AI innovation hub.
